_about: Per-system layout maps for _tools/review/build.py (BOLO 100, ruled 10/4: teach the builder each system's OWN layout; the canon docs are read only). A system with no entry here (02 character) takes the original PART A path. Every value below names a thing the doc itself defines; nothing is invented. Kinds: layers.table (a table whose rows are the layers) | layers.headings (a heading per layer) | layers.bold (a bold line per layer). Field rules: ticks (backticked names) | labels (a regex over lines, one group) | table_rows | table_headers | fence_keys (key: lines in a code fence) | bullet_ticks. 'only' limits a rule to layer ids; 'section' + 'layer' read a named section into one layer. 'extra' maps a layer id to a section whose lines also count for that layer (fields and citations).
